about_the_game:
The following content is included:

●Sticker Set: Blossomdance

Enjoy communicating with your friends via chat!

*You can use stickers in the Communication menu.
*Use the Edit Shoutouts option in the Stickers Sub-menu to edit the text on a sticker.
*This product is also available as part of a set.
*You may need to update to the latest version of the game to use this content.
